name: OCS substep merge strategies
plain: A group can run several substeps per step, from one or more methods, and a merge strategy decides how they combine. simple runs one; supreme_avg averages the substep results and renoises; divide splits the step into smaller sigma steps; overshoot steps past the target and comes back with Restart-style noise; lookahead and pingpong run ahead on a copy and keep part of what they learn.
math:
Symbols: x latent; K substeps; x_k result of substep k.
supreme_avg: x' = Σ_k x_k / K, noise scale averaged the same way.
divide: the step σ→σ' becomes K linear sub-steps between them (linspace).
overshoot: step to a lower sigma, then add noise back up to σ' (Restart rule).

props.merge_methods: simple, supreme_avg, divide, overshoot, lookahead, pingpong, dynamic
